column10: Porter SKIPPED_IRRELEVANT is upheld and strengthened. column10: Skip verified on payload despite the CORE-likely-RELEVANT first-pass guess. column5: UI: Reconfigure quick settings tiles
column10: Skip verified including the #274 pairing. #295 is a one-line replacement of SystemUI quick_settings_tiles_default with AndyYan's personal list 'wifi,cell,hotspot,location,rotation,flashlight'. Porting it would be actively wrong for this device: it would put cell and hotspot tiles in the default QS layout of a modem-less tablet and drop internet/bt/flashlight ordering that upstream provides. Its loose counterpart #274 (packages/modules/Permission, retained) only deletes the SafetyCenterQsTileService <service> declaration from PermissionController's manifest; it does not depend on the SystemUI default-tile string. With #274 applied and #295 skipped the default list still names custom(com.android.permissioncontroller/...SafetyCenterQsTileService), but A16 resolves custom tiles through InstalledTilesComponentRepository/QSHost and silently drops entries whose component is not installed/enabled, so the entry is inert rather than fatal. Both rows are personal-set and never applied by our recipe anyway.

column5: SetupWizard: Least Action(s) Principle
column10: The porter's hand-rebased managed_profile hunk is exact, proven beyond diffstat. Root cause of the drift confirmed as upstream commit 7e4d103 'SetupWizard: Drop LineageOS copyright years' (the A14 hunk starts at line 1 and carries the copyright line as context; the other two hunks start at line 5 and were unaffected). Reconstructed the true A14 post-state independently (git show from the read-only L21 tree into a scratch dir + GNU patch with the original A14 patch) and diffed it against the A16 post-state: the ONLY difference in each of the three files is that upstream copyright line. Additionally the A14 patch made lineage_wizard_script_user.xml and lineage_wizard_script_managed_profile.xml converge to a single blob (47e99c5); the A16 result reproduces that invariant (both md5 7678485dc0941ce866a829606d260e6a; candidate post-index 726319d for both), which proves the hand-rebased hunk is exact rather than merely equal in size. Candidate vs original body difference is exactly one context line; diffstat +3/-120 (62/22/39) preserved; author, subject and Change-Id I892634b8ffc7beafa5a223de0afdc64276efd2f5 preserved.
